|errata_history={{Card errata/Jakku: Rey's Encampment}}
This is the original printed text (version 1 of 6). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:V4-L-Jakku_Reys_Encampment-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]]). The current text is [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; bracketed names such as [Episode VII] stand for icons printed on the cards, and ▲ is the card's icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 4 release ([[Virtual Set 4]]); Players Committee card image<ref name="ht0">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif jakkureysencampment.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 022435b "Set 9 load", 8 July 2018.</ref>: “Light Side: Once per game, may deploy Rey here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Rey deploys -2 here.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif jakkureysencampment.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit e8445f0 "Fixing case and making gifs", 1 June 2022.</ref>: “Light Side: Once per game, may deploy Rey here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Rey deploys -2 here.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same; the card was re-rendered at higher resolution (the side strip and title bar redrawn). A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). No errata mark. The card prints the errata mark “none” although this is change 1 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). Before/after: [[File:V4-L-Jakku_Reys_Encampment-compare-022435b-e8445f0.png|440px]] On 11 June 2022 the PC re-made the card-size GIF at full size (1039×745 pixels; holotable 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”<ref name="ht1b">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif jakkureysencampment.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 6894629 "updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately", 11 June 2022.</ref>; [[:File:V4-L-Jakku_Reys_Encampment-2022-06-11-6894629.png]]); it is pixel-for-pixel the high-resolution PNG of this version (holotable 13a5f3a, 31 May 2022), so it is not a separate version (a later copy of an already published image is a note on that version, not a new one; Bill, 13 and 25 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee high-resolution card image, 15 August 2022<ref name="ht2a">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/002ddc19cbb97e073252a8f78fd963440d351040/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/hires/jakkureysencampment.png jakkureysencampment.png] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), high-resolution folder, commit 002ddc1 "Set 15 release updates/fixes", 15 August 2022.</ref>: “Light Side: Once per game, may ▼ Rey here. Rey deploys -2 here.” and, printed upside down in the Dark Side game-text box, “If Rey present, she may not be targeted by weapons.” '''What changed:''' “may ▼ Rey here” is now printed with the ▼ icon (“may ▼ Rey here”), and the new sentence “If Rey present, she may not be targeted by weapons.” was added, printed in the Dark Side game-text box. No errata mark. The PC replaced this image eleven days later and made no card-size GIF of it. [[File:V4-L-Jakku_Reys_Encampment-2022-08-15-002ddc1.png|440px]]
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”, first published as the high-resolution image on 26 August 2022<ref name="ht3a">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3ed4308531b909a81d213db4d364fab8c38685fc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/hires/jakkureysencampment.png jakkureysencampment.png] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), high-resolution folder, commit 3ed4308 "GEMP Series 4 AIs, fixes", 26 August 2022.</ref>; the card-size GIF of 30 August 2022 is pixel for pixel that image<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3515e91b0f5636658fca65b3ec5bc7d79d105a8f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif jakkureysencampment.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 3515e91 "Fixing case and making gifs", 30 August 2022.</ref>: “Light Side: Once per game, may ▼ Rey here. Rey deploys -2 here. If Rey present, she may not be targeted by weapons.” '''What changed:''' the sentence “If Rey present, she may not be targeted by weapons.” moved from the Dark Side game-text box to the end of the Light Side game text; the words are otherwise the same as the 15 August image. No errata sheet for this change has been found (the August 2022 sheet lists other cards). The card prints the errata mark “E1” (the 15 August image printed none). This is the current text. Before/after, against PC-E1: [[File:V4-L-Jakku_Reys_Encampment-compare-6894629-3515e91.png|440px]]
|hatnote=For the current text, see [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata 3)]].
